sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':11,'col':35}])
print("result:", {k:last_action_result[k] for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','score')})
lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
plines = previous_frame.ascii.split('\n')
diff = [(r,c,plines[r][c],lines[r][c]) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if lines[r][c]!=plines[r][c]]
print("num diff:", len(diff))
# summarize piece positions: find W diamond, O diamond (with M core), G diamonds
import re
def find_pieces(lines):
    W=[]; O=[]; G=[]; M=[]
    for r in range(64):
        for c in range(64):
            ch=lines[r][c]
            if ch=='W' and c>1: W.append((r,c))
            elif ch=='O' and 1<r<62 and 1<c<62: O.append((r,c))
            elif ch=='G' and 1<r<62 and 1<c<62: G.append((r,c))
            elif ch=='M': M.append((r,c))
    return W,O,G,M
def cluster(pts):
    if not pts: return []
    out=[]
    used=set()
    pts=list(pts)
    for p in pts:
        if p in used: continue
        stack=[p]; comp=[p]; used.add(p)
        while stack:
            r,c=stack.pop()
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                q=(r+dr,c+dc)
                if q in pts and q not in used:
                    used.add(q); stack.append(q); comp.append(q)
        out.append(comp)
    return [(sum(x[0] for x in comp)/len(comp), sum(x[1] for x in comp)/len(comp), len(comp)) for comp in out]
W,O,G,M = find_pieces(lines)
print("W clusters:", cluster(W))
print("O clusters:", cluster(O))
print("G clusters:", cluster(G))
print("M:", M)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

# summarize piece positions: find W diamond, O diamond (with M core), G diamonds
import re
def find_pieces(lines):
    W=[]; O=[]; G=[]; M=[]
    for r in range(64):
        for c in range(64):
            ch=lines[r][c]
            if ch=='W' and c>1: W.append((r,c))
            elif ch=='O' and 1<r<62 and 1<c<62: O.append((r,c))
            elif ch=='G' and 1<r<62 and 1<c<62: G.append((r,c))
            elif ch=='M': M.append((r,c))
    return W,O,G,M
def cluster(pts):
    if not pts: return []
    out=[]
    used=set()
    pts=list(pts)
    for p in pts:
        if p in used: continue
        stack=[p]; comp=[p]; used.add(p)
        while stack:
            r,c=stack.pop()
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                q=(r+dr,c+dc)
                if q in pts and q not in used:
                    used.add(q); stack.append(q); comp.append(q)
        out.append(comp)
    return [(sum(x[0] for x in comp)/len(comp), sum(x[1] for x in comp)/len(comp), len(comp)) for comp in out]
W,O,G,M = find_pieces(lines)
print("W clusters:", cluster(W))
print("O clusters:", cluster(O))
print("G clusters:", cluster(G))
print("M:", M)
